title: Listen and Choose a Response — Part-Time Job

questions.stem: Would you be able to cover my shift on Saturday night?

options.A: The shift starts at eight in the morning.
options.B: Yes, I covered the table with a cloth.
options.C: I'll have to check with my family first.
options.D: She worked on Saturday night too.

questions.explanation: Saying you need to check plans is a natural indirect answer to a favor. The distractors misuse 'cover', change the pronoun, or give unrelated details.
questions.speaker: f3
